title: Modelling Seeded Growth of Nanoparticles Far from Equilibrium
content: As modelling the synthesis of metallic nanoparticles leads to useful insights to guiding experiments, we propose a novel numerical suite, NPGrowth based on LAMMPS. NPGrowth enables to simulate the seeded-mediated growth under a variety of conditions, even mimicking the growth under extreme conditions. It allows one-by-one or N-by-N atomic deposition, either when deposited atoms are uniformly distributed or through directional deposition, and atomic deposition onto selected targets, including those remiscent of a chiral molecule. moreover, NPGrowth enables the formation through sintering of two or more seeds, directional, soft-landed or through coalescence. After presenting a few toy models, we discuss the effect of directionality during the sintering of four Cu icosahedral seeds and the importance to identify a sintering geometry following a pySNOW characterisation and classification.
